# Sendbox - Cold Email Platform with Dedicated IPs

> Sendbox (sendboxes.tech) is a cold email sequencing platform with dedicated IPs, isolated infrastructure, and AI-powered warmup on every plan. Built for agencies, SDR teams, and recruiters who need primary inbox placement.

## What is Sendbox?

Sendbox is cold email software purpose-built for deliverability. Every account gets dedicated IPs, isolated sending infrastructure, AI warmup that passes detection, and no per-seat pricing. It is an alternative to Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist, Apollo, Reply.io, Saleshandy, and Woodpecker.

**Category:** Cold email software, email sequencing platform, B2B email outreach tool, email warmup service, cold email infrastructure

## Features

- [Campaigns](https://sendboxes.tech/features/campaigns): Multi-step sequences with A/B testing, conditional logic, and auto-optimization
- [Mailboxes](https://sendboxes.tech/features/mailboxes): Unlimited mailbox connections with automatic warmup
- [A/B Testing](https://sendboxes.tech/features/ab-testing): Multi-variant testing with smart optimization
- [Webhooks](https://sendboxes.tech/features/webhooks): 6 event types with HMAC signature verification
- [Unified Inbox](https://sendboxes.tech/features/unified-inbox): All replies in one place with AI tagging
- [Dialer](https://sendboxes.tech/features/dialer): Built-in VoIP dialer with call recording
- [CRM Integrations](https://sendboxes.tech/features/crm-integrations): HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive
- [Lead Finder](https://sendboxes.tech/features/lead-finder): B2B database with enrichment
- [CRM](https://sendboxes.tech/features/crm): Kanban pipeline with auto-created boards
- [Analytics](https://sendboxes.tech/features/analytics): Campaign performance and deliverability metrics
- [CSV Import](https://sendboxes.tech/features/csv-import): Bulk import with email validation
- [AI Tagging](https://sendboxes.tech/features/ai-tagging): Automatic reply classification
- [ESP Matching](https://sendboxes.tech/features/esp-matching): Routes emails through matching provider
- [SEG Detection](https://sendboxes.tech/features/seg-detection): Detects Secure Email Gateways before sending

## Deliverability

- [Dedicated IPs](https://sendboxes.tech/deliverability/dedicated-ips): Your own IP on every plan
- [Isolated Infrastructure](https://sendboxes.tech/deliverability/isolated-infrastructure): Fully isolated sending per account
- [Human-Like Warmup](https://sendboxes.tech/deliverability/human-like-warmup): AI warmup that passes ESP detection
- [Auto Mailbox Protection](https://sendboxes.tech/deliverability/auto-mailbox-protection): Auto-pause on reputation issues

## Pricing

Pricing is not yet published. See https://sendboxes.tech/pricing for current plans.

All plans include: Dedicated IPs, isolated infrastructure, unlimited email accounts, unlimited warmup, email validation, inbox placement testing, blacklist monitoring, CRM, unified inbox, AI reply tagging, webhooks with HMAC signature verification.

No per-seat pricing. Entire team shares one plan.

## Key Differentiators vs Competitors

| Feature | Sendbox | Instantly | Smartlead | Lemlist | Saleshandy |
|---------|---------|-----------|-----------|---------|------------|
| Dedicated IPs | Every plan | Enterprise only | SmartInfra add-on | No (rotating shared) | No |
| Isolated Infrastructure | Yes | No | Add-on | No | No |
| Per-seat Pricing | No | No | No | Yes ($79-$109/user) | No |
| Built-in Dialer | Yes | No | SmartDialer add-on | Yes (Multichannel plan) | No |
| Starting Price | Not yet published | $47/mo | $39/mo | $79/user/mo | $25/mo |

## Key Facts

- All plans include dedicated IPs and isolated infrastructure
- No per-seat pricing
- Supported providers: Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Outlook, any IMAP/SMTP
- Target users: Cold email agencies, SDR teams, GTM teams, recruiters
- Website: https://sendboxes.tech
- Support: support@sendboxes.tech
